name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Hari Tua (old-age savings)
authority: PP 46/2015 art.16 — 5.7% of the monthly wage, 2% from the employee and 3.7% from the employer. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AO5` = 2% (employee) and `!AR5` = 3.7% (employer); `!AE5` prints the combined 5.7%. NO CEILING: the highest-paid local employee, basic 22,380,750, is charged `AO17` 447,615 = 2% of the FULL wage, and the one foreign employee at 62,000,000 is charged `AK6` 1,240,000 = 2% of the full wage. Both would be clamped if any ceiling applied, and neither is.

name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Pensiun (pension)
authority: PP 45/2015 art.28 — 3% of the monthly wage, 1% from the employee and 2% from the employer, charged on wage up to an annually adjusted ceiling (art.29). SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AN5` = 1% (employee) and `!AQ5` = 2% (employer); `!AF5` prints the combined 3%. The ceiling and its March step are read off the one employee it binds — see ID_BPJS_CEILINGS_OBSERVED. NOT MODELLED HERE: JP covers Indonesian nationals only. The one foreign employee is charged 0 in both `AJ6` and `AM6` on every (FOREIGN) sheet while still paying JHT, JKK, JKM and Kesehatan. Nationality is not a `rate_selector` axis; it belongs on employment_statutory_facts — see ID_JP_FOREIGN_EXCLUSION.

name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Kecelakaan Kerja (work accident)
authority: PP 44/2015 art.16(1) — an employer-only premium banded by the employer's registered work-risk group, in five groups from sangat rendah to sangat tinggi. PP 49/2023 art.16A, in force 6 October 2023, recomposes every rate by 0.14 percentage points into JKP for a wage earner required and registered in the JKP programme, giving 0.10 / 0.40 / 0.75 / 1.13 / 1.60; the art.16(1) rates 0.24 / 0.54 / 0.89 / 1.27 / 1.74 survive only for the art.16A(3) population, which this version does not model. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AS5` = 0.89% and `!AC5` = 0.24% — the art.16(1) rates for class III (sedang) and class I (sangat rendah). The actuals follow 0.89% — Sutoyo `AS8` 65,670 = 0.89% x 7,378,688 exactly, and the foreign employee `AO6` 551,800 = 0.89% x 62,000,000 exactly, at two wages three orders of magnitude apart — so the workbook's risk group is class III, not the class IV the company record states. See ID_JKK_RISK_CLASS_CONFLICT. NO CEILING: the premium is charged on the full 22,380,750 and on the full 62,000,000.

name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Kematian (death)
authority: PP 44/2015 art.18(1) — an employer-only premium of 0.30% of the monthly wage. PP 49/2023 art.18A recomposed 0.10 points of it into JKP from 6 October 2023, but PP 6/2025 art.11, in force 7 February 2025, ended the JKM recomposition and moved JKP's remaining funding wholly onto JKK, so the rate is 0.30% again. art.34 is the JKM benefit schedule, not the rate. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AT5` = 0.3%, corroborated by `!AD5` = 0.3% in the summary block. NO CEILING: `AT17` 67,142 = 0.3% x 22,380,750 and the foreign employee `AP6` 186,000 = 0.3% x 62,000,000, both on the full wage.

name: BPJS Kesehatan (health insurance)
authority: Perpres 82/2018 art.30 as amended — 5% of the monthly wage, 1% from the employee and 4% from the employer, charged on wage between a floor and a ceiling (Perpres 59/2024 art.32(1) and (2) — the third amendment, in force 8 May 2024 — restating the ceiling and floor; art.31 was deleted by Perpres 64/2020 and art.30(2) is the direct-payment rule). The floor art.32(2) states is the workplace UMK, with the UMP only as the art.32(3) fallback; this seed carries the UMP, which is the weaker guard — see NOT APPLIED. SOURCE: `JAN 2026 (LOCAL)!AP5` = 1% (employee) and `!AU5` = 4% (employer); `!AG5` prints the combined 5%. The 12,000,000 ceiling is read off two employees — see ID_BPJS_CEILINGS_OBSERVED. The art.30(2) FLOOR is carried by `FLOOR:MINIMUM_WAGE` against this version's `minimum_wages` map, which `company.region` keys; the source is silent on it, the lowest basic salary anywhere in the workbook being 5,938,885, so no row in the source is floored. NOT MODELLED HERE: Perpres 82/2018 art.30(4) charges a further 1% per family member beyond the fifth. One employee pays exactly 2% in every month; a dependant count is not a `rate_selector` axis. See ID_KESEHATAN_EXTRA_FAMILY_MEMBERS. art.30(4): a further 1% of wage for each family member beyond the fifth — the covered five being the worker, a spouse and three children — borne by the worker. EMPLOYEE_PER_DEPENDANT:20:4 charges one more employee share per head past those four; the regulation states no ceiling, so 20 is a nominal one no household reaches.

name: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan — Jaminan Kehilangan Pekerjaan (job loss)
authority: PP 37/2021 art.43 as amended by PP 6/2025 art.11, in force 7 February 2025 — 0.36% of the monthly wage, of which 0.22% is borne by the Central Government and 0.14% comes from recomposing JKK (PP 49/2023 art.16A). Only that recomposed 0.14% is an employer charge: JKK class III 0.75 + JKM 0.30 + JKP 0.14 = 1.19% of wage, the same total the source workbook's 0.89 + 0.30 charges; only the composition of the payslip lines moves. NOT MODELLED HERE: JKP is open to Indonesian nationals under 54 whose employer is not in contribution arrears. Neither nationality nor JKP registration is a `rate_selector` axis; both belong on employment_statutory_facts.

name: Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 21 (income tax withholding)
authority: PP 58/2023 and PMK 168/2023, in force 1 January 2024 — for every tax period but the last, a permanent employee's withholding is the monthly average effective rate (tarif efektif rata-rata, TER) for the employee's PTKP category applied to monthly gross. Category A is PTKP TK/0 (54,000,000) and TK/1 & K/0 (58,500,000), 44 brackets; category B is TK/2 & K/1 (63,000,000) and TK/3 & K/2 (67,500,000), 40 brackets; category C is K/3 (72,000,000), 41 brackets — all transcribed from the PMK 168/2023 Lampiran. Employee JHT (2%) and JP (1%) reduce the gross, see `relief_for`. NOT MODELLED HERE: the last tax period trues the year up to the annual UU PPh art.17(1)(a) progression after biaya jabatan and PTKP, and employer-borne JKK, JKM and the 4% Kesehatan are additions to taxable gross — see the lineage README.
